title: Archive Light Table — An idea becomes a connected system

scenes.title: Registration and discovery
scenes.purpose: Two translucent acetate plates of an idea's network slide into register on a backlit table; the viewing lens then moves once to the single new link that only the overlay carries.
visuals: Locked overhead view of a pale backlit lamp surface with stationary grid inside a dark bezel
Acetate A (base plate, dashed cool edge, muted network) and acetate B (overlay, cool tinted, ink network plus one new link in saturated blue)
Four registration crosshairs on each plate
Opaque archive tabs: PLATE 07 / BASE A and OVERLAY B
Static opaque caption card with headline
Round viewing lens with 1.8x magnified artwork clipped to the glass circle

beats.development: Opening frame shows offset registrations: both acetates rotated and displaced, networks doubled; headline begins to fade in.
captions: An idea becomes a connected system

beats.development: Acetate A and acetate B slide and rotate independently until their registration crosshairs coincide.
Ticks meet: brief white halos on the four aligned registration marks, then a still hold on the aligned plates.
The lens makes its one move from the lamp corner to the new node; the magnified view pans with it.
A quiet blue ring marks the discrepancy and the status line appears; the composition is settled from 2.68 s.

findings: The slide and the lens move are each one continuous action; there are no extra decorative movements.
The background, bezel and grid stay still the whole time.
justifiedHolds: 1.25–1.62 s: hold after the ticks meet so the viewer can see the alignment before the lens moves, as the style specifies.
2.68–3.0 s: settled reading hold on the status line and the magnified discrepancy.

notes: STYLE.json has no tech.preview_recipes and there is no BACKGROUND_REVIEW.json, so the preview shows the style's core action: two registrations slide into alignment, then the lens moves to the one discrepancy.
Acetate translucency, backlight and the lens glass are approximated with flat SVG opacity, gradients and a blurred shadow. There is no real light transmission or refraction.
